rules.message: Blocks any Edit or Write whose file path contains this substring. Paths are normalised to forward slashes first, so the same rule matches Windows, UNC and POSIX paths.
Conditions are ANDed: this fires only for a model file whose diff also mentions disable_delete. Use this when a blanket path ban would be too wide.
pathRegex, commandRegex and contentRegex take a JavaScript regular expression as a string. Remember that a backslash must be doubled inside JSON.
Rules default to Edit and Write. Declare tools explicitly to guard Bash — this one covers the 'print the git command, do not run it' convention.

action 'warn' prints this and records a WARN line in .claude/agent-guard.log, but lets the call through. Start a candidate rule here, read the log after a week, and promote it to blocking once it has earned it.
